title: Central Finland: 2.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €78,480 a year
markdown:
# Central Finland: 2.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €78,480 a year

> 2.0 more patients a year treated to cure · €78,480 of €1M · €921,520 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Central Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 4.0 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 0.0–8.5) [^model]. Compared with Finland as a whole, the figure is 0.0 (range 0.0–4.2), so there is no shortfall to split between surgery and radiotherapy [^model]. In Central Finland 22.4% are operated, against 15.0% in Finland [^care_surgery].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.2% to 28.7% by 2028: 2.0 more patients a year (range 0.0–2.0), for €78,480 a year, about €40,041 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €27,480 | 1.0 (0.0–2.0) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 27.2% → 28.0% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 1.0 (0.0–0.9) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 27.2% → 27.9% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€78,480** | **2.0 (0.0–2.0)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €841,193 a year; modelled to avoid 1.5 deaths a year (0.3–3.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.2% (2019–2023, measured) → 28.7% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €921,520 buys nothing more [^model]. Measures that add patients treated to cure are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 97 deaths a year in Central Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.3 of them (range 0.0–0.6) [^deaths] [^model].

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 64 new patients and 49 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 1) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 27.2% to 28.0% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities: the lowest and highest values when every assumption moves together from its lower bound to its upper bound [^model].
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
- A county-level check found 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance [^model].

actions.why_here_en: The specialists who decide on surgery and radiotherapy are 146 km away. A fixed weekly slot puts every Central Finland patient in front of them.

In six months that is about 64 new patients and 49 decisions reviewed. pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 64 uutta potilasta ja 49 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 1 heistä (0–1) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 27,2 %:sta 28,0 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
